governance_decisions.statement: Author only governed pedagogical drills; create no new HNK lexical surface form, particle, auxiliary, tense marker, borrowing rule, universal word order, declarative grammar or discourse grammar.
Preserve all WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN labels; AN/EN/KUVAN/KU/KE remain scoped teachable forms only.
PA remains lexical 'ontem'; OPI-008 and STR005 do not establish generic past, temporal syntax, morphology or DID auxiliary.
PITSA remains a controlled loanword example only and cannot establish productive borrowing grammar.
OPI-006 yes/no learner response remains blocked; VANI/VANUVALI remain unresolved and excluded; G-ID remains structural authority and Candidate D non-canonical.
Authoring is not validation. After authoring 72 slots, prepare a separate Activation validation gate and do not validate with the same approval.
